results.title: What is Competitive Advantage? Definition of Competitive Advantage, Competitive Advantage Meaning - The Economic Times
results.content: Business News›Definitions›Marketing›Competitive Advantage. # What is 'Competitive Advantage'. ### Competitive Advantage: Definition. The special strengths and unique skills of a business which allow it to outperform competitors represent its competitive advantage. Competitive advantage of a company include differentiation and cost leadership as well as the capability to focus. In order to maintain a competitive edge, businesses must focus on multiple strategies both for maintaining and developing their position in the market. ### How Can Businesses Achieve Competitive Advantage? * A competitive advantage develops from creating exclusive innovative products along with services which capture attention because of their distinctive features or design elements or technological capabilities and superior customer service. * A business can achieve success when it selects a niche market segment because this strategy enables them to address specific customer requirements that broader competitors usually ignore. * Companies have to establish strong brand recognition to maintain their competitive advantage and become the brand of choice for customers.
